text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: This is a non-review research paper that uses land use and land use change (LULUC) predictions from external global economic models—GTAP and LEITAP—as inputs to assess environmental consequences of converting maize silage-based to grass-based dairy systems in France. While the study includes national-scale context (France), its primary objective is not LULC prediction but rather consequential life cycle assessment (CLCA) of milk production systems. The LULC changes are derived from pre-existing model outputs (Edwards et al., 2010) and are not spatially explicit or mapped; no quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC prediction are reported. The paper does consider multiple scenarios via two different economic models, but it does not implement original LULC modeling or produce mapped LULC projections. Thus, LULC prediction is used incidentally as a step in impact assessment, not as the central focus.)
